text: Tanvi's pregnant!! Due early March. She's off caffeine completely so don't offer her coffee when she comes round.
connor - coeliac, proper strict, not just avoiding bread. also hates mushrooms

Lunch with Lin and Kavya. Kavya's sister Neha just had a baby girl on Saturday, 7lb 2. Lin is doing a dry October and says she's finding it harder than expected. Need to send Neha a card sometime next week.
Alana mentioned the christening is the 12th at half 9, St Mary's. Her husband's family are all coming over from Cork.
Isabel vegan now, since the summer. Bilal still eats anything.
Remind me to ask Ruby how her scan went on Friday at 3pm

So Leah rang, um, she and Gustavo are expecting again, due end of the month actually, which is way sooner than I thought, and she's been really sick the whole time, like can barely keep toast down. Gustavo's mum is moving in for a few weeks after the birth to help out. I should drop off some food, something plain.
aidan nut allergy (tree nuts, peanuts ok apparently??) - check before ordering for the team lunch
Pieter only drinks oat flat whites. Jakub is the espresso guy.
Aditi's baby shower got called off, her mum's in hospital. Check in with her tomorrow morning.
Mabel's grandson was christened yesterday. She showed me about forty photos. His name is Oisín.
Chloe and Dalia - first anniversary Thursday evening, they're doing the tasting menu at that place on Hope St. Chloe doesn't eat shellfish so she'd already checked.
Need to pick up a gift for Chiara's new baby. Was born Monday, a boy called Luis. Something that isn't clothes, she's drowning in them.
Ines said her dad's 70th is sometime in early March, they're thinking a big lunch. He's diabetic so cake is a whole debate.
Khadija fasting Mondays and Thursdays. Don't book lunch meetings with her those days.
Oisín, or Ozzy as everyone calls him, makes his own kombucha and won't shut up about it. Lovely though.
Yasmin's waters broke at 4am this morning! Baby's arrived, both doing well. Text her and Alejandro congrats later today, not now, let them sleep.
Mateo is nervous about the paternity leave conversation with his boss on Wednesday at 10. His partner's due over the summer.
Groceries: oat milk, gluten free pasta, decaf. Pharmacy before 6.
Luis can't have dairy - lactose intolerant. His wife Ayo is the opposite, cheese with everything. Their son Mateo is fussy about everything.
Agnieszka asked whether I'd be godmother!! Christening is end of April, date tbc. Her husband Pieter's parents are doing the food, all Polish dishes.
Lucy loves a negroni. Good to know for her birthday.
follow up w Tanvi re: midwife appt - she went Tues, was waiting on bloods
Connor and his girlfriend Lena are doing a gender reveal thing on Saturday afternoon. Lena's twelve weeks. I'm bringing the drinks, nothing alcoholic for her obviously.
Lin's mum has been unwell, in and out of hospital since September. Lin's stressed and not sleeping. Her brother Jakub is no help apparently. Should call her at the weekend.
Kavya mentioned she's been hinting at a KitchenAid for months. Her husband hasn't twigged.
Dinner party at mine on the 25th, 7.30. Menu needs to work for Isabel (vegan), Aidan (nuts) and Connor (coeliac). Ugh.
Spoke to Alana about the baby. Sleeping through finally, at five months. She's back at work in January, part time, three days.
Neha's little one, Ruby, had her first jabs yesterday, apparently screamed the place down. Neha's knackered and a bit teary about it all.
bilal halal, doesnt drink. ruby veggie but eats fish. gustavo eats literally anything
Note to self: Leah's due date moved to the 3rd. Hospital bag's packed. Gustavo's taking two weeks off.
Pieter and Jakub are both doing Dry January. Pieter said Jakub won't last a week.
Aditi's mum is out of hospital now, home since Sunday. The baby shower is back on, rescheduled for sometime next month. Aditi's due mid-Feb.
Mabel told me her cat Biscuit had to have a tooth out on Tuesday. She was more upset about that than her own knee op next week, which is Thursday at 11.
Don't forget Chloe's birthday is Saturday. She likes really dark chocolate, the 85% stuff, and those fancy gins.

Long call with Dalia tonight. Her sister Chiara is pregnant with twins, which nobody saw coming, and Chiara's partner just got made redundant so they're all a bit panicked about money. Dalia's going over to Lisbon end of November to help for a fortnight. Dalia herself is fine but sounds tired. Her dad's had his hip done too, recovering well. Must send Chiara something for the babies, maybe a double buggy fund thing.
Chiara's in-laws are visiting from Naples next weekend to meet the baby. She says her mother-in-law will only drink espresso from a moka pot so she's bought one specially.
Ines - allergic to penicillin and kiwi fruit. Weird combo.
Khadija's son Ayo starts nursery Monday morning. She's more nervous than he is.
Ozzy brought in a jar of fermented chilli for everyone. Oisín swears it's mild. It is not.

Yasmin says the baby, Lucy, is feeding well. Alejandro's back at work Monday. Her mum is staying till the end of the month. Should pop round sometime next week with a lasagne, she said she's craving one.
Mateo got the paternity leave sorted, six weeks! Relieved.
Ask Luis whether Ayo wants to come to the tasting Friday at 7.
Agnieszka's sister Isabel is getting married in Kraków over the summer. Agnieszka's worried about flying with the baby, he'll be eight months by then.
Book the dentist. Car MOT end of the month.
Lucy and her partner Aidan are trying for a baby. Mentioned it really quietly. She's been off wine since August.
Tanvi had the 20 week scan today at 2. All fine. It's a boy! She's craving pickled onions apparently.
Connor's nan, Nana Mabel, turns 90 on the 18th. Big do at the Legion, afternoon. He wants everyone to bring a photo. Remind me to dig out the one from Blackpool.
Lena said the morning sickness has finally eased off. Her mum wants to throw her a baby shower around Christmas, but Lena's not keen.
Kavya's niece's christening is on Sunday at 11. Kavya's doing the cake, three tiers, egg-free because the baby's dad is allergic.
Dr Nguyen said I should cut back on coffee. Down to two a day starting Monday.
Isabel's boyfriend Bilal proposed last weekend in Edinburgh! Wedding probably over the summer next year. Send her flowers tomorrow, and remember she hates lilies.

Gustavo and Leah's baby came early - Friday night, around 11. A girl, Mabel. Everyone's fine. Leah's in for another night for monitoring. Their older one, Mateo, wants to hold her all the time. I need to sort a present before visiting at the weekend, and Gustavo said absolutely no more teddies.
Aidan's off sugar for a month for some charity challenge. Started the 1st. Very grumpy.
Chat with Mrs Ito next door - her daughter Lena is due in May, first grandchild. She's knitting like mad. Also her dog Kenji is going deaf.
Jakub mentioned his wife Ines has started IVF. Early days, first appointment was last Wednesday. He's anxious. Check in with him in a couple of weeks, quietly.
Pieter's leaving do is Thursday at 6 at the Crown. He's off to a new job in Rotterdam start of December. I said I'd sort the card.
Ayo hates coriander with a passion. Luis grows it on the balcony anyway.

Neha asked me to be at the christening on the 9th at 10am, then lunch after at her mum's. Her mum's doing biryani for 40 people. Remind me to ask Neha if I can bring anything, and ring her the night before to check timings.
Had a lovely evening. Nothing to note really, just good food.
